hooks.text: 在一战战壕部署步兵与初代坦克，用火力支援直接击溃敌军士气
hooks.excerpt: Deploy troops and control the trenches! Make use of the first tanks used in war to dominate the battlefield. Break the enemy morale with fire support and take their ground.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 二战三线拉锯可施放烟幕与压制射击，并由军官呼叫空袭炮击
hooks.excerpt: Engage in the strategic tug of war across three lanes of battle. Fight to complete objectives or win the morale victory by wearing down your enemies. More refined control over your units, order them to throw smoke, use suppressing fire or to advance! Use officers to call in air support and artillery barrages to destroy entrenched enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 突出部战役新增冰雪战线，还要护送车队、清雷与抢占关键路口
hooks.excerpt: Set during the freezing winter of 1944, Battle of the Bulge adds an entirely new campaign to the collection. Inspired by one of WWII’s final major offensives, these missions take players through snowy forests, shattered towns, and desperate defenses on both sides of the front. Hold the line against surprise attacks and push back under brutal conditions. Escort convoys, clear minefields, and capture key crossroads. Face new mission types built exclusively for this campaign.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
